title: Benny Goodman sextet dates and the Russian tour
summary: He made sextet dates with Goodman, did Russian rehearsals but did not go, and had no trouble with him.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Just like Benny Goodman. I made some
dates with his sextet.
When?
Oh, that was before I came here.
Yeah.
That was after I left --
Was Buddy working with the sextet, too?
Who?
Buddy Tate. I don't know whether --
No, no, Buddy wasn't on this date.
Yeah.
It was somebody -- let's see.
Was it Zoot?
Zoot was on one date. And then it changed and then it changed and somebody else was on another date with him.
Yeah.
But he used to call me quite regular when I was in New York, see.
Yeah, I know it means an awful lot to Benny to have somebody sitting up on drums that takes care of business. I always did, with him, and it sounds understandable, doesn't it?
Like when he went to Russia.
Did you go with him?
No, I made the rehearsals for the band and I didn't go back. Something came up and I didn't
make it.
Yeah.
No. And I made the rehearsals with the band.
Yeah.
Instead Jake Hannah, he made it.
Yeah.
And I went out --
I wouldn't want to be in the position of sitting up on drums for Benny if you weren't pleasing him.
Well, I was surprised. I never had any trouble.
I'm sure you didn't. I'm sure you didn't, because he's really --
On the concerts, and --
No, I know you wouldn't, because --
And his manager told me, he says, 'he likes you, he likes your playing.'
Yeah, I'm sure he does. What he suffered was from guys that didn't really swing, and didn't make him happy.
Well, I don't know, but I heard a lot of bad talk about him, on account of the way he act.
Yeah, he can act very badly.
Yeah, I know.
But if he likes what you're doing, he doesn't act badly.
No, no, that's right.
I'll give him credit for that. It's the music. As a general rule, it's the music with him.
Yeah, no problem whatsoever I had with him.
